hackathonProjects.title: FemSTEM
hackathonProjects.description: A web application that serves as an inclusive, supportive tech community focusing strictly on women and non-binaries. Join our Discord server here.

otherProjects.title: Analog Clock
otherProjects.description: An analog clock that will show the time and date on being clicked or hovered and will show the hour, minute and second hands movement. It also has a stopwatch.

otherProjects.title: Last Seen
otherProjects.description: "Last Seen" is a short film that portrays the journey of Shreya, a college going girl who is secretly battling depression. I wrote, directed, captured and edited it.

otherProjects.title: Elizabeth, a Cine Book
otherProjects.description: Winner of CINE-BOOKS & SWEEK, my story got adapted into a screenplay by Marta Syrko. The actors James and Elizabeth were played by Andrii Petruk and Tamri Kogor.

otherProjects.title: Never Again
otherProjects.description: A group of aspiring writers on Sweek.com came together to write holocaust-themed books, stories, plays and poems to raise awareness on International Holocaust Remembrance Day!
